lesson: Use frozen relation-essential evaluation to distinguish real graph reasoning from semantic shortcutting. Expanded capacity was justified only after the harder paired challenge exposed a material compact-model deficit.
reusable_rule: Do not infer capacity sufficiency from an easier dev set when a harder causal/paired gate shows otherwise.

lesson: When several checkpoints solve the new capability, select the earliest checkpoint that also clears retention floors instead of optimizing tiny confidence-margin gains.
reusable_rule: Earliest fully capability-sufficient checkpoint beats later confidence inflation.

lesson: Cross-context fusion must preserve distinct semantic, structured, and evidence views. A single static average would erase disagreement that later uncertainty and identity-control heads need.
reusable_rule: Fuse contexts interactively but preserve per-view contextualized outputs for downstream multi-view pooling.

lesson: Deterministic template text is synthetic generated training material even when no LLM generated it. Provenance must describe how data was actually produced.
reusable_rule: Mark deterministic synthetic templates explicitly as synthetic, non-identity-authoritative training data before any gradient.

lesson: Historical parameter budgets in stage configs must not silently become architecture ceilings after the owner doctrine changes.
reusable_rule: Preserve historical manifests, but add an authoritative current stack-state manifest that explicitly supersedes stale next-stage limits.
